# Navigation API

<div class="doc-meta"><span class="doc-badge">Reference</span> Generated from <code>src/caffeine/script/api/navigation.json</code></div>

Navigation agents: destinations, patrol points, follow targets and behaviour scripts.

## Functions

### `caffeine.navigation.setDestination`

`setDestination(entity, x, y, z) -> boolean`

Sets the agent's destination in world space.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `entity` | number | Entity id. |
| `x` | number | World X. |
| `y` | number | World Y. |
| `z` | number | World Z. |

**Returns:** `boolean` — true on success.

**Example**

```lua
caffeine.navigation.setDestination(npc, 10, 0, 5)
```

### `caffeine.navigation.setMode`

`setMode(entity, mode) -> boolean`

Sets the agent's navigation mode.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `entity` | number | Entity id. |
| `mode` | string | "patrol", "follow" or "scripted"; any other value means idle. |

**Returns:** `boolean` — true on success.

**Example**

```lua
caffeine.navigation.setMode(npc, 'patrol')
```

### `caffeine.navigation.addPatrolPoint`

`addPatrolPoint(entity, x, y, z) -> boolean`

Appends a point to the agent's patrol route.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `entity` | number | Entity id. |
| `x` | number | World X. |
| `y` | number | World Y. |
| `z` | number | World Z. |

**Returns:** `boolean` — true on success.

**Example**

```lua
caffeine.navigation.addPatrolPoint(npc, 0, 0, 0)
```

### `caffeine.navigation.setFollowTarget`

`setFollowTarget(entity, targetId) -> boolean`

Sets the entity the agent follows.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `entity` | number | Entity id. |
| `targetId` | number | Entity id to follow. |

**Returns:** `boolean` — true on success.

**Example**

```lua
caffeine.navigation.setFollowTarget(npc, player)
```

### `caffeine.navigation.setBehaviorScript`

`setBehaviorScript(entity, path) -> boolean`

Sets the script that drives the agent in scripted mode.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `entity` | number | Entity id. |
| `path` | string | Behaviour script path. |

**Returns:** `boolean` — true on success.

**Example**

```lua
caffeine.navigation.setBehaviorScript(npc, 'scripts/ai.lua')
```
